proposals.rationale: Reclassifies C0004 from a statement to a condition record governing the child rules in paragraph d (items (1)-(3): C0005, C0006, C0007, C0008, C0009). Restores the foundational premise to the quote and context, sets relation to scope, and links the governed rules.
proposals.quote: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity. Consequently, under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant:

scope_quotes: to establish the name that best identifies the applicant
fields.scope_text: Under 22 CFR 51.23(c), in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant.
context_quotes: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity.
fields.logic_text: under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant
fields.summary: Because an applicant's name is an integral part of identity, evidence of identity might be required pursuant to 22 CFR 51.23(c) and Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant, establishing governing conditions over subsequent DS-11 procedures.

proposals.rationale: Extracts the exception embedded in 8 FAM 403.1-4(c) that relaxes the prohibition against continuing to use a previous name after a material name change (C0003) when specific authorization exists in the name change documentation.
proposals.quote: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).

fields.scope_text: Applies after a material name change when an applicant seeks to continue using a previous name.
fields.logic_text: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name
fields.summary: As an exception to the prohibition against continuing to use a previous name after a material name change (C0003), the applicant may continue using that name if the name change documentation specifically permits it.

observations.quote: (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C))
observations.rationale: The cross-referenced exception for married names is already accounted for in the governing scope of requirement C0010, while the substantive rules governing married names reside in external section 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).
